DSHA is a DeepSeek Harness entry point that runs locally on your phone. Please read the terms below; by accepting you confirm that you understand and accept all of them.

This app is only a browser shell: you enter the service address and credentials yourself, and the app opens the matching web page on this device. The app does not provide, host or operate any server-side content; whether the service can be reached depends on your own deployment and network.

The service address, username and password you enter are stored only in the private storage of this app on this device and are never uploaded to any server. The app does not verify credentials and is not responsible for the security configuration of your server; do not save credentials on an untrusted device and keep them safe yourself.

The app does not collect or report device information, usage records or page content, and it contains no analytics or advertising components. Data you create in the web page is handled by the service you connect to and follows the privacy rules of that service.

The app is provided “as is”, with no warranty of availability, stability or adaptation quality. The app is not liable for failures or data problems caused by server upgrades, network issues or page structure changes. Do not use this app for any unlawful purpose.
These terms may be adjusted as the app is updated; updated terms ship together with the app and continued use means acceptance. If you do not agree, stop using the app and uninstall it.
